steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each commit deal is placed by its next step and its close date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 commit deal has a close date in the past

findings.title: Commit deal with a close date already past
findings.fix: Re-date the deal or move it out of commit

findings.title: Commit deal with no next step
findings.fix: Set the next step before the call

findings.title: Category total does not match its rows

outcome.notChecked: The buyer's decision; deals outside the export.
